sections.Profile:
The "Wizard!" pinball machine, produced by Bally in 1975, is a notable entry in pinball history. It features the likenesses of Ann-Margret and Roger Daltrey from the movie Tommy , making it one of the first licensed pinball machines. Designed by Greg Kmiec and illustrated by Dave Christensen, "Wizard!" was Bally's highest production flipper game at the time, with over 10,000 units made. The machine is distinguished by its unique "flip flags" on the playfield, a feature rare among pinball games.

- Manufacturer: Bally Manufacturing Co.
- Years made: 1975
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
